dedupe_keys.name: istanbul clean bus fleet transition plan by multi stage stochastic programming

description: This preprint proposes a multi-stage stochastic program to plan the transition of a city bus fleet to clean buses, applied to Istanbul's public bus network, which aims to complete the transition by 2050. The model minimises total expected cost subject to emission targets, budget limits and operational constraints, and treats uncertainty in the cost and efficiency improvements of battery electric buses and hydrogen fuel cell buses as scenarios. A new forecasting approach captures the correlation between these improvements to produce realistic pathways, and a physics-based model of battery electric buses captures energy use and recharging needs. Using real datasets, the authors solve a five-stage program over a 25-year horizon with 256 scenarios to obtain dynamic strategic plans for policy makers. Battery electric buses come out more advantageous than hydrogen buses even when battery technology develops slowly and hydrogen quickly, and sensitivity analyses cover intermediate emission targets, budgets and energy prices. Coverage: Istanbul's bus network. Access: arXiv preprint of 30 October 2024. Licence and cost: free to read. Caveats: a preprint that does not release the input data, and resilience of charging supply is not modelled. It informs investment appraisal, optimisation and capacity planning of transit fleet transitions. It relates to the Istanbul public transport ridership and transport demand model data in the catalogue.
